open_points.subject: A11
open_points.text: a project holding an old date of rule 1 is detected before delivery
open_points.question: Must the Required test show detection for every old-date form in rule 1 (`Z`, `+HH:MM`, and `-HH:MM`), or is one representative form sufficient?
options: Test `Z` and one representative numeric-offset form

witness.initial: One project has a `photo_date` ending in `Z`; another has one ending in `+02:00`.
events: The test author implements the Required tests item.
One author tests only `+02:00`; another tests both projects.
outcomes: The `Z` branch can be implemented incorrectly without failing the required test.
An incorrect `Z` branch is detected by the required test.
witness.observer: The reviewer and later regression-test users

open_points.subject: A11
open_points.text: a project holding none passes that check
open_points.question: Does “none” mean a readable list containing no old dates, an empty photo list, or no `photo_date` values at all?
options: Any readable list with no old dates passes
Only an empty list is the required passing case
A list whose entries omit `photo_date` is the required passing case
open_points.default_guess: Use a readable non-empty list containing only dates that do not match rule 1.

witness.initial: A readable project list contains one photo dated `2026-11-18` and no old date.
events: The calling flow runs the A11 check.
outcomes: The project passes because it holds no old date.
The case is not covered by “holding none”; only an empty list is treated as the specified passing case.

open_points.subject: A11
open_points.text: The calling flow's own stop is shown when that flow exists.
open_points.question: What observations must show the calling flow's “own stop”: the refusal result alone, absence of placement, absence of publication, and/or the owner notification naming the project?
options: Assert only that the check reports refusal
Assert that neither placement nor publication occurs
Assert no placement or publication and assert the owner is told which project needs repair
open_points.default_guess: Assert the refusal, no placement, no publication, and the owner notification identifying the project.

witness.initial: A project has an old date and the calling flow exposes placement, publication, and notification collaborators.
events: The flow detects the old date.
A test author chooses what to assert as the flow's stop.
outcomes: The test asserts only a refusal return value, allowing later placement or publication calls to regress unnoticed.
The test asserts no placement, no publication, and the required owner notification.
witness.observer: The project owner and recipients of an incorrectly delivered photo

open_points.subject: A11
open_points.question: What determines whether the calling flow “exists,” and may the required stop test be omitted until a later state or implementation supplies one?
options: The test is required now for the calling flow named by the rules
The test is required only after a concrete calling-flow module exists
No calling-flow stop test is required if this round has no concrete flow
open_points.default_guess: Treat the named calling flow as requiring a testable contract now; later assembly may bind that contract to the concrete check.

witness.initial: State 2 names a calling flow, but no concrete calling-flow implementation has yet been selected.
events: A later agent evaluates the conditional phrase.
One agent treats the abstract flow as existing; another requires a concrete module before adding the test.
outcomes: A required stop test or explicit test contract is produced.
The stop test is silently omitted.

open_points.subject: A11
open_points.text: A `photo_date` ending in `Z` or in an offset `+HH:MM` or `-HH:MM` is an old date.
open_points.question: Are `+HH:MM` and `-HH:MM` lexical suffix shapes or valid time-zone offsets, including valid digit and range requirements, and are matching and whitespace handling exact?
options: Any literal suffix matching sign plus two characters, colon, and two characters is old
Only syntactically and numerically valid offsets are old
Only exact uppercase `Z` or digit patterns with valid offset ranges are old, with no trailing whitespace
open_points.default_guess: Match exact uppercase `Z` or a numeric `±HH:MM` suffix with valid offset ranges and no trailing characters or whitespace.

events: The calling flow classifies the suffix under rule 1.
outcomes: A lexical matcher treats the value as an old date and stops delivery.
A valid-offset parser rejects it as malformed rather than classifying it as an old date, so the A11 old-date check does not produce the specified refusal.

open_points.subject: A11
open_points.text: A `photo_date` ending in `Z` or in an offset `+HH:MM` or `-HH:MM` is an old date.
open_points.rule:
У значения, которое читает генерируемый код, ровно три пути; путь
выбирается по тому, что это за значение, и у значения один дом (§15.4).
open_points.question: The passage must either name this closed suffix policy through one of the three permitted paths—normally an imported provider constant—or state it only as a design fact that generated code does not read.
